## Use case and boundaries

Describe the problem, scope and known limitations. Link the relevant issue.

## Verification

List exact commands, results and skipped checks. Include fictional regression cases and benign controls.

- [ ] No real credentials, personal data or proprietary platform imports.
- [ ] No telemetry, remote masking or new runtime dependencies.
- [ ] Strict types, bounded input and established restoration boundaries preserved.
- [ ] Behaviour changes have regression tests; skipped tests are not reported as passed.
- [ ] Public documentation and examples are in English.

Use SECURITY.md for private vulnerability reports, not this pull request.
